how_jobs_are_offered.title: How jobs are offered
how_jobs_are_offered.description: The rules behind the job board: what you see, what happens automatically, and how to ask a person to look at a decision.
how_jobs_are_offered.board_text: Every approved partner sees the same open jobs. The board shows the jobs in the market you work in, in the currency you are paid in. By default they are listed by when they were posted, and you can sort the list yourself. A free place goes to whoever takes it first.
how_jobs_are_offered.preferred_title: When a customer asks for you
how_jobs_are_offered.preferred_text: A customer you have cleaned for can ask for you by name. You then have the first place on that job to yourself for a limited time, which is shorter the sooner the clean is. If you do not take it in that time, or you release it, it goes to the open board for everyone. Releasing it is never held against you.
how_jobs_are_offered.radius_text: We tell you about new jobs automatically. If you set a distance on your profile, we tell you only about jobs within it; if you do not, about every new job in your country. The distance changes only the notifications: the board still lists every job, and you can take any of them.
how_jobs_are_offered.automatic_text: A few things happen on their own: a customer's request for you ends at its deadline and the job opens to everyone; a job with nobody on it shortly after its start time is cancelled and the customer is refunded; we remind you of the jobs you have taken; and if a job you have taken has not been started shortly after its start time, the company's administrators are told automatically. None of these steps decides anything about you or changes which jobs you can take: what happens to a job that was not started is always decided by a person.
how_jobs_are_offered.no_score_text: We do not score partners or put them in order. Ratings do not change which jobs you see or can take. The only limit on how many jobs you take is a weekly limit an administrator may set for you; if one is set, you see it and its reason on your profile.
how_jobs_are_offered.approval_text: Before you can take jobs, an administrator approves your account. They check that your profile is complete, that every document the country you will work in requires has been uploaded and accepted, that you have accepted the partner documents in force, and that we operate in that country. Approval and rejection are always decided by a person, never automatically.
how_jobs_are_offered.review_title: Ask a person to review a decision
how_jobs_are_offered.review_text: If you disagree with a decision about your account or your jobs, such as a rejection, a removal from a job or a weekly limit, write to support@cleansia.cz. A person, not an automated system, will look at it and answer you.

orders.step2_desc: Claim an order to add it to your assignments. The customer is notified.
orders.step3_desc: Perform the cleaning, take before/after photos, and mark as complete.
orders.step4_desc: Your earnings are added to your next invoice for the pay period.
